hypothesis: reorder_items only validates itinerary membership on items[0]. An attacker providing their own item at index 0 can tamper with arbitrary third-party items at index 1..n without authorization check scoping.
Broadcast channel messages lack schema validation and sender membership verification, allowing arbitrary participants to poison SWR cache or crash local React state via malformed event payloads.
EditableDailyTips lacks string length bounding and control character sanitization, permitting oversized payloads (>1MB) to flood the realtime broadcast channel and PostgreSQL column.
Offline SyncQueue replays static req.headers from time of enqueuing. If session expires while offline, replay sends stale JWT resulting in 401 and silent discard after 3 retries.
